text: The Skullcannon digs in, shrieking skulls arcing high over wall and field. It cannot move while deployed.
The Skullcannon tears free and lumbers back into the hunt, trading great arcs for armour-piercing shot.
A Skullcannon dug in as a fixed siege howitzer. Its bound flesh strains and screams, hurling skulls in great arcs, heedless of all beneath.
